explanation.value: Let X be deﬁned as number of black pens in n independent trials. p is the probability of success. p = xx +y , 1−p = 1− xx +y = yx +y Given, process is repeats n times with replacement. E(X) =np =n× xx +y For example: x=10, y=20 and n=10 Let X be deﬁned as number of black pens in 10 independent trials. p is the probability of success. p = 1010 + 20 = 13, 1−p = 1− 13 = 23 Given, process is repeats 10 times with replacement. n = 10 E(X) = 10× 13 = 103
